thread:
alex: FYI acme POC hitting 401s when hitting /v1/generate, started after we swapped keys.

maria: ugh, timeline? Did they rotate anything on their side?

alex: They said they copied a token from a personal profile into the app config. Error looks like org-binding problem. Posting logs: 

alex: ```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_personal_abc123\" \\ \n  -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp\" \\ \n  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json

{\n  \"error\": \"invalid_token\",\n  \"message\": \"token_org_mismatch: token bound to 'alex-personal', request org 'acme-corp'\",\n  \"code\": 401\n}
```

sam: that message matches token bound-to-org checks. We validate token.owner_org == request.org for org-scoped tokens.

jordan: Can we confirm whether the token is project-scoped vs org-scoped? project tokens will also reject if wrong project header.

alex: Customer app uses header `X-Redwood-Project: acme-proj-42`. Their original token was project-scoped to `project-7` (different). Example failure when project mismatch: 

alex: ```
{\n  \"error\": \"invalid_scope\",\n  \"message\": \"token_project_mismatch: expected project 'project-7' got 'acme-proj-42'\",\n  \"code\": 403\n}
```

maria: They're also worried about rate limits — saw a spike before they rotated keys. Could be two separate issues. Do we have recent quota logs?

bot-deploy: deployment: acme-prod (region: us-west-2) - avg RPS 5.4, 95th latency 210ms, token_errors 37 in last 10m.

sam: Token errors spiked exactly at 14:07 UTC when infra team tested token refresh. So likely user replaced token with an unscoped/incorrect token.

alex: Quick remediation path I suggested: 1) generate a new token in the Acme org console -> ensure scope `inference:invoke` and binding Org=acme-corp, Project=acme-proj-42 (if app requires project). 2) swap into app config and restart service. 3) if they need programmatic rotation, use `rdwctl tokens create --org acme-corp --project acme-proj-42 --scopes inference:invoke` (internal helper).

jordan: Could they be hitting SSO-bound tokens? If their SSO issues ephemeral tokens, we should confirm expiry header.

alex: Good call. Log shows `expires_in: 3600` on their initial token, but the one they pasted was long-lived personal. Recommend using org-managed token.

maria: Sales question — while we're here, they asked if rotating to org-managed keys affects pricing / quotas. Short answer?

sam: No pricing delta for org-managed vs personal keys. Quotas are enforced on org/account tier. If they switch to a different org-level billing account then quotas/pricing could change.

maria: OK I'll tell them that — also they asked for a one-page note for security to confirm keys are auditable and rotateable. Can someone paste a short blurb?

alex: Sure: \"All tokens issued by Redwood can be listed and revoked via the console and API. Tokens are logged (issuance, last-used) and can be bound to orgs/projects and scopes. For customers with stricter controls we support KMS-backed rotation and short-lived SSO tokens.\"

jordan: Back to the POC: I can repro locally with the wrong token. Steps I used: 

jordan: ```
# simulate wrong token
export RW_KEY=sk_live_personal_abc123
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp\" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/ping | jq
```

jordan: Response shows `token_org_mismatch`. When I swap to org token `sk_org_acme_xyz` call succeeds.

alex: Great. Action items: 
- alex: share console link and instructions to generate org-scoped token.
- jordan: send repro snippet to their engineer.
- sam: check quota spike correlation and confirm no rate limiting side-effects.
- maria: update customer on pricing+security blurb.

maria: I pinged their eng lead, they replied: \"we were using a personal token while waiting for org admin to complete onboarding — will rotate now.\" :thumbsup:

alex: After they rotated it, can we watch for any 4xx/5xx during next 15m?

bot-deploy: monitoring: starting 15m watch window for acme-prod. alerts: none yet.

jordan: Confirmed with customer — new token bound to acme-corp + project acme-proj-42. Calls successful, no errors after swap.

maria: closing loop with legal/security Q: they asked if we log which admin created tokens. alex, can you confirm?

alex: Yes console shows creator metadata and last-used timestamp. We include that in the short blurb.

maria: Perfect. I'll send final note and close POC ticket. Thanks team. :tada:

sam: re: rate limits — I'll open a follow-up if the quota spike recurs.

alex: Thanks everyone. Leaving notes in the CRM and marking POC as \"auth fixed\".

jordan: moving to separate thread for performance tuning and pricing for dedicated capacity.

maria: kthx bye.
